description:
Hi, 
 

 This is Raju. I am Recruiter at Randstad Technologies and I am reaching out in regards to your background. I have an exciting opportunity
  *Candidates MUST be able to work on W2 to qualify for this role.* 
 
 
 Job Title: Certified Java Developer with Both Java and C# 
 Duration: 6 Months 
 Position Type: Contract to hire 
 Location: PLANO, TX 
 Job Description: Java Certification 7-plus years of hands-on Core Java, Shell Scripting and Linux development experience

 7-plus years of hands-on experience in Oracle relational database: SQL, Procedure/Function and performance tuning proficient

 5-plus years of hands-on ASP.Net, C#. VB.Net, Java Script, VB Script, HTML, CCS development experience

 Proficient with Microsoft Excel Macro Development

 Proficient with Java Multithreading, Messaging, Strings, and Hibernate

 Proficient with XML file parsing, XSL and XSLT

 Proficient with Linux Shells scripting, PERL, Tools and Utilities

 Proficient with Oracle SQL Loader

 Proficient with Eclipse, Visual Studio, Team Foundation Server, Ant, Jenkins, Autosys, Toad

 Proficient with Microsoft .Net Framework and Web Technologies

 Proficient in Microsoft IIS, Linux Redhat and Window server

 Experience with DB2

 Experience with Large Data Files, File Transfer, and ETL Tool Development

 Strong technical and analytical skills with ability to trouble-shoot complex technical issue in demanding environment

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 Please have a look at the below job requirement and reply back to me with your latest word format resume ASAP. Do let me know the best contact number to reach you. 

 Note : If you feel this job description does not suit your profile then kindly let me know your preferred job roles so that I can be in touch with you with similar jobs and you can refer me a suitable person for this job as well. Hope to hear from you soon.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
